rules.title: Weekly slope-displacement monitoring — high-wall benches

applicability.description: Opencast mines with high-wall benches above 30 m

rules.escalationRule: Auto-escalates at deadline to Area General Manager

evidenceChecklist.title: Bench 3B crest photo
evidenceChecklist.guidance: Crest showing berm markers and crack gauge in frame

rules.statutoryBasis: DGMS (Tech) Circular No. 02 of 2020 — Guidelines for Systematic Monitoring of Slopes in Opencast Coal Mines (real PDF bundled in data/regulatory/)
